document_findings.label: Nonconforming signs
document_findings.text: Relocation, enlargement, damage and structural changes have nonconforming-sign consequences; evaluate the complete provision.

document_findings.label: Temporary signs
document_findings.text: Special temporary-use certificate, duration, size and circumstances are conditional; not a blanket temporary-sign allowance.

document_findings.label: Illumination
document_findings.text: Shielding and a printed 1987 IES reference require technical/currentness review; no inferred electrical code edition or office.

document_findings.label: Special signs requiring certificates
document_findings.text: Some fee-free special signs still require zoning certificates; distinguish fee, certificate and other permits.

document_findings.label: Special signs exceptions
document_findings.text: Conditional special-sign provisions do not establish building or electrical exemptions.

document_findings.label: Office district signs
document_findings.text: Office freestanding and wall sign allowances require district, frontage and full-section review.

document_findings.label: Variable message signs
document_findings.text: Variable-message limitations require reading complete conditions and adjoining pages.

document_findings.label: Commercial ground signs
document_findings.text: Commercial freestanding allowances require confirmed district, frontage, area and setbacks.

document_findings.label: Commercial wall signs
document_findings.text: Facade-based area, projection and clearance provisions are research candidates, not approved job limits.

document_findings.label: Industrial district signs
document_findings.text: Industrial district and nonresidential H applicability requires address and district confirmation.

document_findings.label: Prohibitions and promotions
document_findings.text: Roof, off-premise, vehicular and bench provisions plus special promotions require exceptions review.

document_findings.label: Certificate triggers and maintenance
document_findings.text: Routine maintenance including lamps, ballast and electrical components requires a zoning certificate but no fee in this retained code. No electrical exemption inferred.

document_findings.label: Application documents
document_findings.text: Printed application content includes scaled design and illumination details and a site plan signed by a registered surveyor; verify current intake requirements.

document_findings.label: Enforcement
document_findings.text: After-the-fact certificates and penalties do not authorize work in advance.

document_findings.label: Fee schedule effective date
document_findings.text: Section 2 specifies January 1, 2026 for the fee schedule, with applications filed earlier subject to the schedule in effect when filed. Current applicability pending.

document_findings.label: Missing fee attachment
document_findings.text: Section 1 references Appendix 1, but both retained pages contain the resolution only. Fee amounts cannot be extracted from this archive.

document_findings.label: Fee resolution adoption
document_findings.text: Printed adoption December 9, 2025 observed visually; signatures and OCR vote transcription are not staff authority verification.

document_findings.label: 2026 planning and zoning authorization
document_findings.text: Authorizes execution of county Regional Planning Commission zoning administration/enforcement assistance contract for 2026. Does not establish execution or electrical roles.

document_findings.label: Missing contract attachment
document_findings.text: Section 1 refers to Exhibit A; no exhibit appears in the two retained pages. Detailed terms and execution remain unresolved.

document_findings.label: Contract authorization adoption
document_findings.text: Printed adoption December 9, 2025; Section 6 uses earliest period allowed by law, not a calculated effective date.
